content.title: 2026 Venezuela World Baseball Classic Roster
content.text: Skip to content Search With the 2026 World Baseball Classic set to begin in March, the preliminary roster for Venezuela is here. Initial rosters are subject to change. Read on below for our team summary and breakdown of top players and prospects to know. Find all of our WBC coverage here. Team Summary: For a baseball-rich country like Venezuela, the WBC has been fraught with disappointment. Their fifth-place finish in the 2023 WBC was the country’s second-highest finish in five tournaments. Things could be different in 2026, however, as the Venezuelans have one of the best lineups in the tournament led by a star-studded outfield of Ronald Acuna Jr., Jackson Chourio and Wilyer Abreu. The pitching doesn’t compare to the United States but does feature a mix of a dozen current big league starters and relievers. Top Players: Ronald Acuna Jr. is one of the best players in the world when healthy. He’s just two years removed from an all-time season and could provide true impact in the middle of the Venezuelan lineup. Ranger Suarez just signed a lucrative multi-year contract with the Red Sox and gives the Venezuelan rotation a tough lefty capable of efficiently navigating lineups. The Venezuelan catching duo of William Contreras and Salvador Perez is arguably the best in the tournament, with Perez providing veteran leadership and Contreras bringing a great balance of hitting ability and defense. Jackson Chourio is one of the brightest young stars in the game and will add a bunch of offensive firepower behind Acuna in this talented Venezuelan lineup. Best Prospects: No player on the Venezuelan team is still prospect eligible. Like with the Dominican Republic, this is a roster full of MLB regulars. Pool D Venezuela Dominican Republic Netherlands Israel Nicaragua Dates/Location: March 6-11, Miami, Florida.
